cards.text: THE VIVIENNE — B-ROLL LIBRARY V1

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Twelve reusable b-roll shots for any Vivienne ad, in four groups. These are KEYFRAMES for approval, nothing is rendered yet. Engine is Google Omni (VO ads animate on Omni; Seedance 2.5 is lipsync only). No shot may ship as a zooming still. Approve the shots you want and I animate only those.
A1

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Chocolate, the hero. Covers HOOK, PRODUCT INTRO and CTA in the work and everything scripts.
Slow push-in, three-quarter front, weathered wood and dark teal wall

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Settled, considered

Two-tone: chocolate body, contrasting cognac straps

Slow lateral drift, one specular highlight travels across the brass

cards.title: B · MATERIAL MACROS — 3s each  ·  Weekender real-product stills wired as hardware reference

cards.text: C1

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Lifting it by both top handles. The body sags and folds under its own weight.
The lift, then the bag settles

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Weight, substance

Carry truth: top handles are hand or elbow only. Her hand spans a fraction of the width, which sells the 38cm.

Press and release

C3

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Fingers turning the brass oval plate closed.
The turn itself, a few degrees over the post

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Mechanical satisfaction

The only closure-interaction shot. The flap stays CLOSED throughout, no interior is ever revealed.

cards.title: C · HAND INTERACTION — 2.5 to 3s each  ·  New keyframes, this pass

cards.text: D1

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Hand carry at her side, walking. The bag reaches mid-thigh.
Walk, the bag swings and sags

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Everyday, unbothered

Sells the scale against a body. Top handles, the honest carry.
D2

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: On the detachable shoulder strap, bag against her hip.
Walk, slight sway

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Hands free

The detachable strap is the ONLY legitimate shoulder carry. The top handles cannot reach a shoulder and must never be staged that way.

cards.title: D · CARRY — 4s each  ·  Weekender hand-scale still wired for true size

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: APPROVAL GATE
cards.text: These are keyframes only. Tell me which shots to animate and I run them through Omni. Nothing renders before that.

cards.title: What is deliberately missing
cards.text: No open-bag, no interior, no packing or loading shots. The lining, pocket count and pocket type are unconfirmed, so any interior would be invented. Confirm the interior and this library grows by two shots.

cards.title: No real footage exists
cards.text: Nobody has filmed a physical Vivienne. The three TikToks in source/tiktok are third-party and reference-only under the DMCA law, so they can never ship. When samples land, refilm A1, C1, C2, D1 and D2 for real and retire the generated versions.

cards.title: The OFFER beat is a screen recording
cards.text: Every script ends on a capture of the live PDP showing $149.99 struck through from $199.99. That is a real recording, not a generated frame, and it should be shot the day an ad ships so the price on screen is the price that day.

cards.title: Coverage
cards.text: A 30s VO ad needs eight or nine visuals at one every ~3.5s. Twelve clips plus the PDP recording covers all three scripts with room to re-cut.
